# aside

Hands browser tasks to Aside, the user's own AI browser with its own logged-in agent, through the aside CLI, in a split terminal pane when the terminal plugin is present. An alternative to browser-use for work in the user's accounts. Needs the aside CLI.

| | |
|---|---|
| Version | `1.0.0` |
| Marketplace | [`magus`](./index.md) |
| Commands | 1 |
| Subagents | 0 |
| Skills | 1 |
| MCP server | no |
| Hooks | no |

## Install

```bash
magus
```

Find `aside` on the Plugins tab and turn it on. magus registers the `magus`
marketplace if you do not have it, and installs what the plugin needs to actually run —
binaries, MCP servers, CLI tools.

For a team, press `s` to save your plugins as a profile and commit it. Everyone else runs
`magus install` — see [Teams and profiles](../../guides/teams.md).

Prefer to do it by hand? [Installing Magus](../../guides/install.md) has the manual path.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/aside:doctor` | Checks that the aside CLI is installed, an account is signed in and the Aside hosts are reachable, and says what a task would run on. Changes nothing. |

## Skills

| Skill | What it covers |
|---|---|
| `aside:aside` | Hands a task to Aside, the user's own browser and agent, through the aside CLI. Use when the work is in their accounts (my Slack, Gmail, Linear, GitHub, calendar) or they mention Aside; |
